Definition: (in a good sense) transport (with love), or (in a bad sense) stultify; to make cakes
BiblicalUsage: 1) to ravish, become intelligent, get a mind; 1a) (Niphal) to take heart, become enheartened, become intelligent; 1b) (Piel) to ravish the heart, encourage, make heart beat faster; 2) (Piel) to make cakes, bake cakes, cook bread
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
